content.short: Valantis builds stHYPE, a liquid staking token on Hyperliquid, together with a dedicated AMM.
content.description: Valantis is a modular AMM framework whose Hyperliquid deployment centres on stHYPE, a liquid staking token, paired with an AMM designed around it. Building the exchange venue alongside the LST addresses the usual weakness of liquid staking tokens, which is that the peg only holds as long as there is somewhere deep enough to trade it.
